name: Plastic chair
short_description:
Stackable PP plastic chair, indoor & outdoor, easy clean, for canteen, school, F&B and community centre
Heavy duty injection moulded plastic stacking chair, waterproof for commercial public areas
description:
Chair Shell: Made of brand-new polypropylene (PP) reinforced with glass fiber and manufactured using a one-piece molding process. The shell surface features a square grid pattern consisting of 25 horizontal and 21 vertical cells, with a thickness of 7mm, ensuring structural stability. The surface texture is neatly arranged and tightly interlocked like fish scales, shimmering with a subtle glow to create a unique visual effect. The hollowed-out area in the center of the backrest is like the blank space left by the agile posture of a fish, complementing the "fish scale" texture. The seat and overall shape are clean and smooth, combining aesthetics with practicality. Complies with GB 32487-2016 General Technical Requirements for Plastic Furniture.
Chair Shell Dimensions: Back height: 350mm; Back width: 440mm; Seat depth: 470mm; Seat width: 460mm. The hollowed-out section of the chair shell measures 350mm in length and 80mm in width. The chair shell thickness is 7mm, ensuring structural stability.
Frame: Constructed from high-quality steel with a diameter of 19mm and a wall thickness of 1.5mm. It features a cantilever (bow-shaped) structure and is treated with pickling and electroplating or electrostatic powder coating. The overall stability is exceptionally high. Material inspection must comply with GB/T 3325-2017, QB/T 3832-1999, and QB/T 3827-1999, and pass a continuous 24-hour acetic acid salt spray test.
Testing Standards: Tested according to general office chair standards. It can bear a load of 180kg. The backrest undergoes a one-time tensile test of 108kg with a 1-minute pressure hold. The PP backrest passes a 120,000-cycle push-back test at 40kg. The surface is waterproof, free of any watermarks and burrs, and designed to meet ergonomic requirements. (Optional upholstered seat cushion available for the seat).
Overall Chair Dimensions: Seat height: 470mm; Seat depth: 470mm; Seat width: 460mm; Total height: 840mm.
Standard Colors: Available in 7 colors (Black, White, Grey, Red, Green, Yellow, Purple).

Stackable PP plastic chair, indoor & outdoor, easy clean, for canteen, school, F&B and community centre
Heavy duty injection moulded plastic stacking chair, waterproof for commercial public areas
description:
Chair Shell: Injection-molded from virgin polypropylene (PP) with fiberglass reinforcement, the chair's design resembles an elegantly blooming petal. The overall lines are smooth and natural, flowing seamlessly from the backrest to the seat. The soft and dynamic curves at the edges are akin to a petal's contour, creating a light and rhythmic feel that offers a gentle and beautiful visual experience. The minimalist shape embodies delicate beauty, like a petal gently stretching in a breeze, injecting natural agility and elegance into the space. It serves as both a practical functional item and an artistic piece, enhancing the aesthetic atmosphere of the environment. The back features a decorative cover securely installed using ultrasonic technology, presenting a fashionable and minimalist overall look. Complies with GB 32487-2016 General Technical Conditions for Plastic Furniture.
Shell Dimensions: Backrest Width: 440mm, Backrest Height: 440mm, Seat Depth: 450mm, Seat Width: 460mm. Shell Thickness: 7mm for structural stability. Decorative Cover Dimensions: Width 140mm, Height 80mm.
Base: Metal four-leg lounge base with a height-adjustable gas lift system and silent casters. Surface is powder-coated in black or white. Material inspection must comply with GB/T3325-2017, QB/T3832-1999, and QB/T3827-1999, and pass a continuous 24-hour acetate salt spray test.
Testing Standards: Tested according to general office chair standards with a load capacity of 180KG. The backrest withstands a one-time tensile test of 108KG with pressure maintained for one minute. The plastic backrest passes 120,000 cycles of a 40KG push-back test. The surface is waterproof, free of watermarks and burrs, and designed to meet ergonomic requirements. (Optional upholstered seat cushion available).
Overall Dimensions: Seat Height: 500mm~560mm, Seat Depth: 450mm, Seat Width: 460mm, Total Height: 900mm~960mm.
Standard Colors: Available in 5 colors (Black, White, Grey, Red, Green).
